fields.title: Community record
fields.description: One record per input URL. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures), a normalized set of value-add fields (communityName, memberCount, subscriptionPrice, estimatedMonthlyRevenue), and the platform's own upstream object verbatim under `raw`.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The URL/slug that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-nextdata (Skool __NEXT_DATA__), S1-html-rsc-scan (Whop regex extraction from its RSC payload), or none on failure.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions (e.g. not_found, not_found_or_private, unexpected_shape, blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

memberCount.title: Member count
memberCount.description: Total members shown by the platform. This is an all-time/all-tier count on both platforms -- it is NOT limited to currently-paying subscribers, so it will overstate the paying member base for freemium communities.

isPaid.title: Is paid
isPaid.description: Skool: the community's own `membership` flag. Whop: true if at least one recurring plan with a price was found.

subscriptionPrice.title: Subscription price
subscriptionPrice.description: The disclosed price, if any. Skool: {amountUsd, currency, interval, monthlyEquivalentUsd} parsed from the community's own `displayPrice` field -- many paid Skool communities do NOT expose this to guests (null in that case). Whop: {monthlyEquivalentUsd, currency} -- the cheapest recurring plan found across the community's access-pass product pages.

estimatedMonthlyRevenue.title: Estimated monthly revenue (MRR estimate)
estimatedMonthlyRevenue.description: memberCount x monthly price -- an UPPER-BOUND triage signal for sponsorship/lead scouting, not verified revenue. Neither platform publishes actual revenue publicly. Null when price wasn't disclosed.

estimatedMonthlyRevenueBasis.title: MRR estimate basis
estimatedMonthlyRevenueBasis.description: Explains how estimatedMonthlyRevenue was computed, or why it's null.

raw.title: Raw upstream data
raw.description: Skool: the full `currentGroup` object from __NEXT_DATA__, passed through verbatim (totalMembers, totalAdmins, totalOnlineMembers, membership, membershipModel, displayPrice, description, category, etc). Whop: the fields this actor's regex extraction could find (id, title, creatorPitch, route, memberCount, reviewsAverage, publishedReviewsCount, accessPasses, plans) -- not a full page passthrough, since Whop's RSC payload isn't valid JSON to begin with.
